items.title: 10.2.2 Finding the oxidation number of an element in a compound or a radical (compound ya radical mein element ka oxidation number nikalna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2.2 with Sample Problems 10.1 to 10.3 and Quick Check 10.1, printed pages 215-216.

blocks.text: Compound ya radical mein kisi element ke atom ka oxidation number (ya state) oopar diye gaye rules se nikala ja sakta hai.
Compounds of a metal with a non-metal (metal aur non-metal ke compounds)
Metal ka Ox. No. hamesha positive aur non-metal ka negative hota hai. Misal ke taur par sodium sulfide, Na₂S, mein:
Compounds of a non-metal with a non-metal (do non-metals ke compounds)
Do different (alag alag) non-metals wale compound mein Ox. No. ka nishan har atom ki electronegativity par depend karta hai. Sab se zyada electronegative element ko negative nishan milta hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 10.1
blocks.problem: Sulfur dioxide, SO₂, mein S ka oxidation number nikalein.
steps: Har O atom ka Ox. No. = −2
SO₂ par koi charge nahi, is liye kul Ox. No. zero hai:

blocks.text: Compound ions woh ions hain jin mein do ya zyada different atoms hon, jaise sulfate ion SO₄²⁻ aur nitrate ion NO₃⁻.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 10.2
blocks.problem: SO₄²⁻ mein sulphur ka oxidation number (Ox. No.) nikalein.
steps: [S ka Ox. No.] + 4 [O ka Ox. No.] = −2 (ion ka charge)
blocks.answer: SO₄²⁻ mein sulphur ka oxidation number +6 hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 10.3
blocks.problem: KMnO₄ mein manganese ka oxidation number (Ox. No.) nikalein.
steps: (K ka Ox. No.) + (Mn ka Ox. No.) + 4 (O ka Ox. No.) = 0
blocks.answer: KMnO₄ mein Mn ka oxidation number +7 hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har sawal ka ek hi tareeqa hai: (1) jin atoms ka Ox. No. fixed hai (K +1, O −2) woh likhein, (2) maloom na wale atom ko x maan lein, (3) sab ka sum compound ke liye 0 aur ion ke liye us ke charge ke barabar rakh kar x nikalein.

blocks.prompt: a) Electron transfer ke hisaab se oxidation aur reduction ki definition (tareef) misalon ke saath karein.
blocks.explanation: Oxidation electrons ka khona hai: Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻. Reduction electrons ka lena hai: Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu.

blocks.prompt: b) Oxidation number ki tabdeeli ke hisaab se oxidation aur reduction ki definition misalon ke saath karein.
blocks.explanation: Oxidation number ka barhna oxidation hai (Fe²⁺ se Fe³⁺: +2 se +3). Oxidation number ka ghatna reduction hai (Cl₂ se Cl⁻: 0 se −1).

blocks.prompt: c) Ox. No. nikalein: i) Na₂O mein oxygen ii) ICl₃ mein iodine iii) NO₃⁻ mein nitrogen iv) K₂Cr₂O₇ mein chromium.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Quick Check 10.1 c (i) mein “Oxygen (N) in Na₂O” chhapa hai; oxygen ka symbol O hai, N (nitrogen) nahi. Sahi: Na₂O mein oxygen (O).

items: Metal + non-metal: metal positive (Na₂S mein S = −2).
Do non-metals: zyada electronegative element negative.
SO₂ mein S = +4, SO₄²⁻ mein S = +6, KMnO₄ mein Mn = +7.
